text: <The battered sign reads Stoker's Coffin Motel.||Motels like these are cheap, each room only large enough to fit a small bed.||Dumps like these tend to attract the dregs of humanity.>
<The manager yawns.>||I won't bore you with the welcome speech.||So whadda' ya' want?
Just looking for a place to crash.
I'll talk to you later, chum.
<Some of those dregs leap from the shadows.||You are forced back into the street where they attack!!>
I got a room for 20$, up front.||You interested?
<Stoker squints at you with his one good eye.>||Here's the package.  Don't slot this up!
Do you have the package, breeder?||Or have you lost it?||<He grabs the package from you, checks it, and begrudingly pays for your service.>
I'm here to pick up Michael's stuff.
Small change.  Slot this cred and I'm gone.
250$?!!  How much could he have stored in one of those rooms?!

So, you're Michael's brother, eh?||Your bro' skipped on paying his bill and I'm holding his stuff 'til I get the back rent.||Lets make a deal.||You pay up the 250$ he owes and I'll fork over his stash.
Hope you brought your own towels.||I've been cleaned out this month.||Enjoy your stay.
Your stick seems to be low on creds.||I'm sorry, but we can only board paying customers.
Hey, if you need nuyen head up the street to the Jump House.||Gunderson is always looking for runners.||You'll find him in a booth towards the back of the bar.
